title: [finding] spec(migrations): the ui-html-page-div-refused entry's why text says dev and start run compile first; they do only when the artifact is missing or --compile is passed
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a measured `reach:`**, class **(a)**, one location. Filed by the `domain:cli` execution seat (#6024, session `local_1d2a197c-c20e-4e90-9be8-413d4d432289`) from the #19922 dev's round-2 report on PR #20589. ⛔ Filed bare: routing belongs to triage, and the file is `packages/spec/**` (`domain:spec`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## The defect

The semantic ledger entry `ui-html-page-div-refused` (PR #20610 for #20592, on `main` from `7510663c87`), in `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-html-page-div-refused.ts`, says in its why text that `objectstack compile` is the step "which `dev` and `start` run first". They do not always run it:
- `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts:319` compiles only on `flags.compile` or a missing `dist/objectstack.json`, and `dev.ts:383` re-runs it in watch mode;
- `packages/cli/src/commands/start.ts:228-232` has the same condition.

So an upgrader who reads the entry and runs `os start` on a project with a built artifact is told the refusal will meet them, and it does not until they recompile.

- **`reach:`** the public door `objectstack migrate meta`. The #19922 dev measured `--from 17` on a stack with a `div` page at PR #20589's head `77338a7186`: the entry is listed among the manual changes, headed "⚠ [protocol 18] kind:'html' page source …", and its why text carries the sentence.
- **When it ships:** Version Packages PR #20639 (open) carries `.changeset/20592-ui-html-page-div-refused.md`, so the next release publishes this text in `@objectstack/spec`.
- **Already flagged, not filed:** the at-tier review of PR #20610 (`5885908398`) flagged the same phrase, and the spec seat relayed it on #19922 (`5886241963`). PR #20589's changeset has corrected its own copy of the phrase. The ledger entry's copy is the one left.

## The fix shape

Reword the why text to the exact condition: compile runs on `os compile` / `os build`, and on `os dev` / `os start` when the artifact is missing or `--compile` is passed (and on each rebuild in `dev`'s watch mode). One file. Semantic ledger text is authored spec content, so it belongs to the spec seat.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "which \`dev\` and \`start\` run first" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/migrations` answers 1 hit today, and 0 once fixed.

Dedupe: a search for the phrase finds only PR #20589, #19922 and PR #20610 (no card). Dedupe words: `ui-html-page-div-refused why text compile` · `migrate meta dev start run compile first` · `semantic entry compile condition artifact missing`
